text: I'd like an animation of a coffee cup sitting on a rainy windowsill, with steam curling upward from it. I love that little feeling of comfort when it's raining outside, which is why this idea appeals to me. For the animation itself, I want it to be 6 seconds long and widescreen, with a cosy illustrated look. There shouldn't be any text or sound. Just tell me your plan before making it.
